source_claim: Reporter describes farmer accounts of drying maize and beans in named lower-belt Kween localities; individual observation dates and plot boundaries are not verified.
boundary_status: Analyst-selected Ngenge locality proxies, not official administrative boundaries or verified Makunga farm parcels

epochs.interpretation: Early-season context before the source's approximate mid-March onset; actual crop stages unknown
Observation dates preceding publication; not proof of historical data delivery

selection: One successful six-band acquisition per area/epoch/year; rank by scene cloud then timestamp and ID; at most three distinct acquisition attempts; do not select by observed NDVI

rainfall.comparison: MAM total versus median of the four reference years; not climatology or drought diagnosis

limitations: All area boxes are correlated; sensitivity and nearby context are not independent controls
WorldCover 2021 is historical cropland context, including hindsight for earlier reference years
Calendar, current crop identity, management and exact farms unconfirmed
Retrospective reprocessing; no lead-time, causal attribution, yield-loss or irrigation claim
Published field accounts are not field-level supervised labels
